scoring_justification: Headline quantities are total energy differences and magnetic moments from full DFT relaxations; recomputing them in the verifier sandbox is infeasible, so reported values are compared to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for each scored quantity
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: magnetic_moment_isolated=2.0 μB, delta_E_spin_polarization=187 meV, delta_E_FM_AFM_undoped=36 meV (AFM favored), delta_E_FM_AFM_doped=-39 meV (FM favored), magnetization_per_defect_doped=1.4 μB (at 0.6 h/defect), spin_polarization_at_EF=0.73
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's narrative and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the original study, providing a valid reproduction target.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the six headline reproduction quantities. The hidden checker compares each field to the paper-reported gold values using absolute tolerances and directional overrides where the paper states that a larger or more negative value is better (e.g., larger spin-polarization energy gain, more negative energy difference for doped FM).

output_contract.notes: All quantities are computed from the DFT relaxations specified in the workflow steps. The target policy for the file is 'exact_match' with per-field tolerances and directional logic implemented in the hidden checker. No further scored artifacts are required.

steps.description: Total magnetic moment of isolated V_Siad defect
Energy gain from spin polarization (positive = spin-polarized lower)
E_FM - E_AFM for undoped two-defect supercell (positive = AFM favored)
E_FM - E_AFM for 0.6 h/defect doped two-defect supercell (negative = FM favored)
Magnetization per defect in doped FM case
Spin polarization at Fermi level for doped FM case
